## Before opening an issue

- Reproduce the problem with the latest builder release.
- Check the [Morphe Desktop issues](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-desktop/issues)
  for patch-engine problems.
- Do not include APKs, keystores, personal data, or private tokens.
